verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents registrable outbound HTTP webhooks that an external consumer can subscribe to for Appwrite events. Functions can be triggered *by* incoming webhooks or by server events (appwrite-docs-9, appwrite-docs-64), and the docs mention responding to server events in realtime (appwrite-docs-28). Those are inbound triggers, event-handler building blocks and an adjacent realtime feature, so they earn no credit toward the story.
